title: Day 1 : Bagdogra Airport (IXB) / New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) Arrival and Transfer to Gangtok
text:
Welcome to the charming land of North East. An agent’s representative will receive you at the Bagdogra Airport/New Jalpaiguri Railway Station and escort you to your hotel. Upon arrival, register yourself at the reception and relax for some time. The first day of your vacation trip to Gangtok can be spent at leisure.
Stroll around the local markets or satisfy the palate with scrumptious Tibetan food.
You can spend the rest of the day at leisure or go for a walk to Mahatma Gandhi (MG) Marg Gangtok, a great place to chill out in the evenings. The country’s first litter and spit-free zone, no vehicular traffic is allowed into the Marg.
After a well-spent day, come back to the hotel to mark an end to your first day of North East Gangtok holiday.

title: Excursion tour to Baba Mandir and Tsomgo Lake
text:
Hop off to Tsomgo Lake, the paradisal stunner of North Sikkim, and seek Baba Harbhajan blessings at the most popular temple of North Sikkim on the second day of your Gangtok Darjeeling trip itinerary.
Wake up to the refreshing smell of hills and have a filling breakfast before proceeding for the day’s sightseeing tour. Set off on your excursion to Tsomgo Lake near Gangtok. Known for changing colours, the Tsomgo Lake is among the most visited tourist attractions in Gangtok.
Further, visit the famous Baba Mandir built in fond memory of Late Major Baba Harbhajan Singh. Return to your hotel and end this tiring day of your Gangtok-Darjeeling holiday with a revitalising dose of sleep.
Tip:- You can also visit the Nathu La Pass (Interline Permit Required, Charges Extra)
Distance from Gangtok to Tsomgo Lake: 40 Km

title: Gangtok to Darjeeling drive
text:
Good Morning!!! have a Delicious Breakfast and drive to Darjeeling and reach by late afternoon.
In the morning gallivant away to Darjeeling. Breathe in the delicious aroma of tea as you ride through the winding roads to this charming little hill town on your 6th day Sikkim Darjeeling holiday.
Upon reaching your hotel, complete your hassle-free check-in formalities and head to your room.
After some rest In the evening walk along the mall road & visit chowrasta (The Mall) and Mahakal temple situated near mall road.
After a well-spent day, come back to the hotel overnight stay.
Tip: you can enjoy the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway joy Ride. First hill railway in India also known as Toy train (Book Directly from IRCTC, Charges extra). Come back to the hotel.

title: Darjeeling City Tour with Sunrise at Tiger Hill
text:
Wake up early morning & get to Tiger Hill and gaze upon phenomenal orange hues of the sunrise over Mt. Kanchendzonga. Stop by at the alluring Ghoom Monastery & check out the elegant Batasia Loop, a quirky Toy Train railway track that spirals around the Gorkha War Memorial.
Return to your hotel and have breakfast. Set out for a full day city tour of Darjeeling. Advance to the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute (Close on Thursday), visit the largest high altitude zoo in India – PNZ Zoological Park (Close on Thursday). Sip on a hot cup of refreshing Darjeeling tea and go for a delightful ride on the Darjeeling Ropeway (charges extra).
Later visit Tenzing Rock and Gombu Rock and Tea Garden
Also visit Tibetan Refugee Self Help Center (Close on Sunday)
End the day’s sightseeing by paying a visit to the divine Japanese Temple and Peace Pagoda. Return to your hotel and call off the last day of your vitalising Darjeeling & Gangtok tour package with some reviving sleep.

title: Departure – Darjeeling to Bagdogra Airport (IXB) / New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP)
text:
Your memorable North East tour package itinerary comes to an end this day leaving yours with sweet memories of the trip to Darjeeling.
Post breakfast, complete check-out formalities and proceed to Bagdogra Airport/NJP Railway Station to leave for your onward destination with nostalgic memories of your North East holiday.
